bugs.text: Soft-lock: pressing Enter enters 'stagestart'; when stageTimer runs out buildStage() is called but it never sets G.state to 'playing', so update() keeps returning at line 301 forever. The STAGE 1 banner stays on screen for the whole session (screenshots 4-play-015s..075s and 5-end), no enemies ever appear and no input does anything.

The player ship is never created at stage start. G.player is null from reset() and makePlayer() is only called from the respawn branch, which requires a prior death. Even with the state fix, the fighter would not appear and updateDive (233) would throw on G.player.x.

Once stageTimer<=0, buildStage() runs on every fixed step (60x/s), resetting all enemy arrays and calling sJingle() each time; after any keypress has created the AudioContext this produces a continuous audio-spam jingle.
spawnChalWave() is never called, so a challenging stage could never spawn enemies; line 164 also assigns to undeclared 'e' under 'use strict' and would throw ReferenceError if called.
capture() and beamAt() are never called: the tractor beam can never catch the player, so capture, dual fighter, rescue and captive fire can never occur.
Formation table has 6 Boss Galaga and duplicate Zako slots (42 entries, overlapping positions) instead of 4/16/20.
No P (pause) key; Space also starts the game from the title.
The title screen turns into a GAME OVER / HIT RATIO 0 % screen after 26 s of idling, then resets; a results screen with no game played.
Dual fighter can put 3 shots on screen (guard at n>=2 then pushes two).
Shooting a Boss in formation leaves the captive alive (empty comment blocks where the logic should be).
Stage badges: no 5 flag, ones not shown from stage 10 up, stage 30+ draws a 30 plus a 20 flag.
Hitboxes exceed sprite sizes (boss 12x12 vs 6x6; player 10 wide vs 7).

summary: The file is compact, syntactically clean and has the right skeleton (fixed-timestep loop, G state object, update/render split, pixel sprites, synthesized Web Audio, a reasonable title screen and HUD), and the play-test harness reported no console errors. But the game is missing its one essential state transition: nothing ever sets G.state to 'playing' and nothing ever creates the player at stage start, so after Enter the screen shows STAGE 1 forever while buildStage() and the jingle re-fire every tick. Every gameplay feature in the rubric, from entry paths and dives to the tractor beam, challenging stages and scoring, is written to some degree but is dead code; several of those paths (capture, spawnChalWave) are additionally never called even in principle, and the formation table has 6 bosses with overlapping Zako slots. What is on screen (title, starfield, HUD) looks Galaga-like; as a game it never starts.
